item.title: Riverside County real estate developer set to buy graffiti towers in downtown Los Angeles
item.description: A proposed buyer for the so-called graffiti towers in downtown Los Angeles was announced on Monday.

item.title: Federal agents in California don't have to visibly display their badges for now, judges say
item.description: Federal law enforcement officers in California don't have to visibly display their badges for now, a panel of appellate judges said.

item.title: Pregnant woman murdered in Ventura County identified after 45 years
item.description: A pregnant woman found stabbed to death in the parking lot of a Thousand Oaks high school has been identified 45 years after her murder.

item.title: Over 70 people killed in attempt to capture Mexican cartel leader and violent aftermath
item.description: More than 70 people died in Mexico's attempt to capture the notorious leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the violent aftermath of his death.

item.title: Summer-like temps return to SoCal this week. Here's when things will heat up
item.description: Southern California will continue to see mild and sunny conditions, and later this week, many areas will see summer-like temperatures.

item.title: US women's gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Los Angeles County High School for the Arts students walk out of class in protest of ICE raids
item.description: Students at Los Angeles County High School for the Arts walked out of class on Monday to protest the ongoing immigration raids.

item.title: Aisha Dee reveals all about her Hulu series 'Watching You'
item.description: "It affects you in a way that's really unexpected." Aisha Dee unpacks the drama in "Watching You." The psychological thriller is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Robert Carradine, 'Revenge of the Nerds' and 'Lizzie McGuire' actor, dies at 71
item.description: Robert Carradine, the actor known for his roles in "Revenge of the Nerds" and "Lizzie McGuire," has died at the age of 71.

item.title: Coyote caught on video chasing 3-year-old boy outside of Pasadena home
item.description: The video shows the toddler headed for the car when he stops in his tracks and races back inside. The coyote can be seen following right behind him.
